story.label: First expedition
story.value: Begin at Farmstead of the Quiet Beast. Lift the curse affecting the disputed bell, on which whoever takes from it is followed home. Lift the curse affecting the abandoned family vault, on which the same hour repeats for anyone who stays past dark. Each section has its own holder and marked threshold. The other listed sites are additional jobs in the same region.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v2; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: Stakes
story.value: The local faction wants the work completed before rivals can claim its outcome. Failure leaves the claim unsettled; success gives the party a result they can bring back and defend.
story.source: dossier-story.ts v2; stored templates + explicit record links

story.label: At the table
story.value: The associated encounters use the listed reaction rolls. Treasure is allocated to the listed sites, but its discovery and access still need to be resolved in play. Tarot meanings are prompts; they do not add an unlisted power or compel an outcome.
story.source: Published dossier assembly and play policy

faction.agenda: Preserve independent marsh rights and trade medicinal herbs to anyone with silver.

npc.quirk: Offers formal salutes; will not tolerate dishonor.
npc.interaction: Secretly spying for a regional faction or baron.

reading.title: STATUE
reading.description: A statue depicts the god Istus offering the original Deck of Many Things as a gift. The Statue card is a reminder of the past.
reading.meaning: Someone who takes great pride in a prominent ancestor.

faction.name: Coven of Bittermold
faction.agenda: Brew potent curse draughts and awaken slumbering primeval powers beneath the mounds.

npc.quirk: Counts coins while talking; assesses your gear value.
npc.interaction: Seeking honorable single combat to prove their prowess.

reading.title: OOZE
reading.description: A gelatinous cube with various items suspended inside it creeps through a vaulted sewer. The Ooze card indicates the importance of something that seems lowly or innocuous.
reading.meaning: An art object depicting an Ooze or the destruction of a particularly notable Ooze; alternatively, a magic item useful against Oozes (such as a Ring of Acid Resistance).

reading.description: A clawed hand reaches to grab an emerald ring, which disintegrates at the claw's approach. The Talons card indicates greed or the rapacious hunger of a predator.
reading.meaning: A tenement or workhouse where oppressed victims of the rich live in squalor.

reading.title: FIEND
reading.description: A balor strikes from the depths of the Abyss. This card alludes to an actual Fiend or the forces of the Lower Planes.
reading.meaning: A redeemed Fiend or similar creature that has lost its connection to the Lower Planes.

reading.title: RUIN
reading.description: An elegant sword and crown disintegrate into eddies of ash. The Ruin card warns of the inevitability of decay and the danger of material attachments.
reading.meaning: A treasure that is broken or in disrepair.

reading.title: PRIEST
reading.description: A cleric holds a heavy mace. The Priest card represents wisdom, insight, closeness to the divine, and divine magic.
reading.meaning: A situation caused by impiety or misguided zealotry.
